1479-2841-6158-7889.description:

Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

465-670-1008-1619.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
465-670-1008-1619.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Undermountain Adventurer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, it triggers, returning Undermountain Adventurer from exile to the battlefield.
When Undermountain Adventurer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Undermountain Adventurer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Undermountain Adventurer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
Repeat from step 5.

Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Kydele.
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Kydele.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Kydele.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Kydele from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Felidar Guardian that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 3.

Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.

Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Nissa, Worldwaker

Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

Repeat.

1364-1371-4398-5158.description:
Cast Endless Swarm by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Eye of the Storm and Hive Mind trigger.
Resolve the Eye of the Storm trigger, exiling Endless Swarm, and then copying each instant and sorcery card exiled with Eye of the Storm, and allowing you to cast the copies without paying their mana costs.
Choose not to cast the copy of Endless Swarm as permitted by Eye of the Storm.
Resolve the Hive Mind trigger from step 2, causing each opponent to copy Endless Swarm.
Resolve the first opponent's copy of Endless Swarm, causing them to create a 1/1 Snake creature token for each card in their hand, and then be unable to cast spells for the rest of the game.
The Snakes enter the battlefield and die as a state-based action due to having less than 0 toughness.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining Endless Swarm copy.
At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, their copy of Endless Swarm triggers, copying itself.
Resolve the copy of Endless Swarm, causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Snake creature token for each card in their hand.
The Snakes enter the battlefield and die as a state-based action due to having less than 0 toughness.
Repeat from step 9.

Activate Dragon's Eye Savants's morph ability by revealing a blue card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

Choose to have each Clone token enter the battlefield as a copy of Blightsteel Colossus.
Deal combat damage to each opponent using a Clone token, causing each opponent to get eleven poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

1000-2087-2493-4872.description:

Cast Spore Swarm by paying {3}{G}, creating three token copies of Archaeomancer.
Each of the Archaeomancer's ETBs trigger, returning Mystic Reflection, Time Warp, and Spore Swarm to your hand.
Repeat.

After your draw step, The Mirari Conjecture triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation to your hand.
Repeat.

3350-3859-4551.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Axis of Mortality triggers.
Activate Cavern Harpy by paying 1 life.
Repeat step 2 until you have zero life.
Resolve the last Cavern Harpy trigger, returning it to your hand.
The remaining Cavern Harpy triggers fizzle.
Resolve the Axis of Mortality trigger, swapping your life total with an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
You may repeat this on each of your turns.
